notes:
LitArbi is now in beta!
• Insert Citation is a compact palette again — it can no longer balloon, and “⇥ Dock” pins it as a slim column on the right edge of your screen, beside Word.
• Exhibit list: right-click the column headers to choose which columns are shown and to reset widths; no column can grow past a sane cap any more, and columns wider than the pane now scroll horizontally instead of vanishing.
